{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check if any non-numeric values remain
print(sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum(), 'non-numeric values in revenue')

# Check for any non-integer values in 'converted'
print(sales_df['converted'].unique())"}
